claims.quote: Self-limited familial infantile epilepsy (SFIE) is largely associated with variants in proline-rich transmembrane protein 2 (PRRT2).
Nine patients who had first-line treatment of oxcarbazepine (OXC) became seizure-free.

initial treatment with levetiracetam (LEV) or sodium valproate (VPA) in eight and three patients, respectively, was not effective even after increasing the dosage, and seizure-free status was only achieved after changing the treatment to OXC.

claims.object_text: PRRT2 variants as a biomarker to help select antiepileptic drugs for SFIE
claims.quote: PRRT2 variants may be used as a biomarker to help select antiepileptic drugs for SFIE.
